Greetings, Agents!
 
This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Spider-Man’s nemeses, the Sinister Six, have gained new powers!

 

In this additional patch, check out the new uniforms for Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus, and Electro, 
and meet Electro, Mysterio, Vulture, and Sandman,
who have become even stronger through Potential Awakening and Transcendence.

 

Check out the new looks of the Super Villains who have gained new powers
by downloading the 4/12 patch.

 

■ 4/12 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 4/13 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 4/12 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT) 
* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances and the completion time will be further noticed once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch. 
* When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 

[4/13 (Wed) 2:52 (UTC+0), 4/12 (Tue) 19:52 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 3/30 (Wed) 3:44 (UTC+0), 3/29 (Tue) 20:44 (PDT). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

▣ 3 New Uniforms
 

Spider-Man’s nemeses have returned with stronger powers and amazing looks!
Three new <Spider-Man: No Way Home> themed Uniforms will be added.  

 

Check out the abilities of the three new Uniforms, 
Green Goblin <Spider-Man: No Way Home>, 
Doctor Octopus <Spider-Man: No Way Home>,   
and Electro <Spider-Man: No Way Home>!  

 

 

 

* The three new Uniforms can be purchased after the 4/12 patch data has been applied 

and a 40% discount event will be applied to the new Uniforms.
* The new Uniform can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* The skills stats are based on the maximum skill level and Tier.

 

▣ Electro, Mysterio, Vulture, and Sandman Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential
​
Electro, Mysterio, Vulture, and Sandman 

are now available for Potential Awakening and Transcendence!
Check out the threatening chain attacks of the four Super Villains!

 

 

 

 

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

New Artifacts have been added for Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus, 
Electro, Mysterio, Vulture, and Sandman.

 

* The effects are based on 6★ Artifact passive skill LV.4 stats.

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
and hope you look forward to the new Uniforms of the three Super Villains.

 

Thank you.
